archetypes.name: Spot-up shooter
archetypes.description: Spaces the floor: far more of his shots are threes than for others his size.

archetypes.name: Rebounding forward
archetypes.description: A big body who rebounds and stays inside, rarely creating or shooting threes.

archetypes.name: Pass-first point guard
archetypes.description: Small, sets up teammates and pressures the ball; scoring is secondary.

archetypes.name: Scoring wing
archetypes.description: A wing who looks for his own shot more than most, without running the offense.

archetypes.name: Low-usage role player
archetypes.description: Plays minutes without needing the ball: below-average volume and efficiency.

archetypes.name: Rim protector
archetypes.description: Blocks shots and controls the glass; efficient, low-usage finisher, no threes.

archetypes.name: Combo guard
archetypes.description: A smaller guard who splits scoring and playmaking; since the three-point line, a high-volume shooter.

archetypes.name: Star creator
archetypes.description: Takes over possessions: elite scoring volume and usage, plus real playmaking.

archetypes.name: Scoring big
archetypes.description: A frontcourt focal point: scores, rebounds and blocks shots with high usage.

archetypes.name: Stretch big
archetypes.description: A power forward or center (6’9”+) who shoots threes far more than players his size, pulling a defender away from the rim. Scored on a sliding scale by an explicit rule: too rare for clustering to separate.
